# Pandamonium v1.0.69

This operator-requested follow-up fixes the confusing Soundboard Settings entry screen reported after installing v1.0.68. The scope is the search prompt and its browser check. Rollback is signed v1.0.68 with the updater snapshot.

## MAD-968 — Myinstants: give Jarvis a soundboard with favorites and response-positioned audio

### Problem

Opening Soundboard requested recent sounds, whose upstream failure displayed “Soundboard unavailable” even though searches worked.

### Implementation

An empty search now shows “Type a sound name and press Search.” without a request. Opening the tab respects an existing query. Submitted searches retain normal results and error handling.

### Product value and UI visibility

Settings → Soundboard opens with a useful instruction instead of a misleading failure. Empty submissions clear old results and stay local.

### Verification

Reproduced the installed empty request returning503 while a real query returned20 results. Four focused Chromium checks cover the empty entry state, blank submission, search, preview/favorites/mute, text cues and voice effects. Required CI and signed updater checks remain enforced; installed verification is recorded separately in MAD-968.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No dependency, package, data schema or voice changes. Myinstants1.1.1 remains installed. The Settings starter feed is replaced by explicit search; actual upstream search failures still surface. Cache426 delivers the updated UI. Rollback retains v1.0.68 and owner data.
